name: Coffee punch cards
summary: Whose turn it is to buy the coffee round: a café punch card per friend, stacked by the rounds they bought this month; the thinnest stack is up next with the order on its card, and buying thunks a stamp on yours.
useWhen: a regular coffee or boba run where people take turns buying: 'whose turn is it at kettle & crumb'
someone keeps dodging their round: 'calvin you said i'll get the next one 4 times'
keeping score of who bought rounds this month
dontUseWhen: splitting one bill right now (use a bill split)
settling debts across many expenses (use settle-up)
picking where to get coffee (use a poll)

run.description: What the run is called, e.g. 'fenwick grind'

order.description: This round's order, 1 to 4 lines, e.g. 'Arun's chai'

joke.description: The running excuse and how many times it was said
